summary: When you commit to something, you bring a force that doesn't quit. Drive and raw power flow together in you, giving you stamina and nerve most people can't match. You regenerate from setbacks.
body: When you commit to something, you bring a force that doesn't quit. Drive and raw power flow together in you, giving you stamina and nerve most people can't match. You regenerate from setbacks. You can go all-in, survive what flattens others, and come back stronger. Because it comes easy, the risk is overwhelming people without noticing, or leaning on sheer force instead of strategy. Aim the power with some precision and you're close to unstoppable.
gift: At your best: relentless, regenerative, built for what wears others down.
shadow: The trap: leaning on raw force and steamrolling people without clocking it.
integration: Let drive and anger and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Formidable drive; temper and overkill are the dangers.
do: Aim the power with precision, not just force
Use the stamina on something worthy
Notice when intensity overwhelms the room
dont: Take the regenerative power for granted
